Search summary of Baqueira's official technical-data page and guides: 169 km of marked pistes plus 4 km of itineraries; 127 'tracks' plus 3 itineraries; 36 lifts = 1 gondola (9-seat cabins), 18 chairlifts (12 detachable, 6 fixed-grip), 10 surface lifts (including 2 rope tows) and 7 conveyor belts (recorded under other); transport capacity 62,013 people/hour. Another result gave 5 green, 33 blue, 25 red, 6 black pistes (69).

character: Baqueira Beret is Spain's largest ski area, in the Val d'Aran on the northern side of the Catalan Pyrenees, spread over the Baqueira, Beret and Bonaigua sectors. It has about 169 km of marked pistes and 36 lifts with an uphill capacity of about 62,000 people per hour.
